what: Plan updates plan-review.md but the actual external plan-review prompt is emitted by render-plan-review-prompt.sh, and the plan does not add that renderer or its harness to the change set
scenario_or_breakage: Step 3 Cursor/Codex reviewers keep receiving prompts without expanded readability guidance, so reviewer finding text and OOS descriptions miss a stated amendment site despite plan.txt line 106 saying helper-rendered prompts must substitute the token
suggested_fix: Add render-plan-review-prompt.sh and test-plan-review-prompt.sh to the plan; read the shared preamble and inject the expanded style text into the heredoc, with a harness assertion that rendered prompts contain the style guidance and no raw <READABILITY_STYLE> token

what: Plan calls the new guard a pre-commit lint but only wires Makefile lint targets
scenario_or_breakage: CI lint-only, local git pre-commit, and scripts/relevant-checks.sh run pre-commit, not ad hoc Makefile lint prerequisites, so the manifest guard can be skipped on normal validation paths; the new harness also will not run in the CI test-harness matrix if it is only added to master lint
suggested_fix: Add a local .pre-commit-config.yaml hook for scripts/lint-readability-preamble.sh with pass_filenames false/always_run as appropriate, and assign test-lint-readability-preamble to one test-harnesses-N shard instead of relying only on the top-level lint target

what: Plan omits Gate B's plan rewrite and dedup path from the readability amendment sites
scenario_or_breakage: Gate B rewrites final plan.txt after accepted review findings, then Gate C and Step 5c publish that revised plan; without reading the style preamble there, the final design can lose the required brief/dyslexia-friendly style after review
suggested_fix: Add a MANDATORY read directive for readability-style.md before the Gate B Apply-all body/shared post-apply rewrite, and include approval-gates.md in the lint manifest as an orchestrator-inline site
